LESSON: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Modes of preservation of the Qur’an
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Modes of preservation of the Qur’an, part of Qur’an in Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an? 2. How is the Qur’an preserved in modern times?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online/ from available reference materials on the modes used in preserving the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently and present on charts/PowerPoint,

2. recite selected chapters/verses from the Qur’an/ digital devices and present them in class,

3. read chapters/verses from the Qur’an,

4. discuss the significance of preserving the Qur’an and make notes. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online/ from available reference materials on the modes used in preserving the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently and present on charts/PowerPoint,
2. recite selected chapters/verses from the Qur’an/ digital devices and present them in class,
3. read chapters/verses from the Qur’an,
4. discuss the significance of preserving the Qur’an and make notes. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Modes of preservation of the Qur’an together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: Enhanced as learners acquire personal skills as they recite some chapters/verses of the Qur’an

• Digital literacy: Enhanced as learners adopt and develop new ideas when researching on the modes used in

preserving the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently and

present on PowerPoint

• Communication and collaboration: Enhanced as learners acquire the skills of listening and respecting other

people’s views when discussing the significance of preserving the Qur’an in groups.

• Learning to learn: the skill of research is acquired as learners research on the modes of preserving the Qur’an during the

time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently and present on PowerPoint

Values:
Respect through respecting others’ opinions as they discuss the significance of preserving the Qur’an

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion enhanced as learners discuss the significance of preserving the Qur’an in groups
